periods.time: During the rescue crisis and the following wedding arrangements
periods.label: 愤怒的父王与认可婚礼的岳父

name.jp: シリウス・ヴァーミリオン

status.volume_role: angered father and political ally in Stella's rescue

personality.summary: Sirius reacts first as an enraged father, threatening war if Stella is harmed, but once he understands Itsuki's resolve he trusts the plan and cooperates. By the wedding preparations he still grumbles but has accepted Ikki as Stella's husband.
flaws: anger can derail negotiations until Astrea intervenes

relationships.stella-vermillion: Beloved daughter whose kidnapping enrages him.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Queen who manages the actual diplomacy when Sirius is too angry.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law; Sirius complains but has allowed the marriage after Ikki fulfilled his promise.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Initially berates him for the kidnapping but later trusts his rescue strategy.
relationships.john-cobland: Son-in-law through Lunaeyes; physically drags Sirius away so talks can proceed.

periods.summary: When Itsuki reports Stella's abduction, Sirius explodes in rage, demanding Japan deploy all forces and threatening war if Stella is harmed. Astrea has John drag him away so diplomacy can continue, but Sirius returns calmer after hearing Itsuki's plan and recognizes the parental motive behind it. He agrees that Vermillion will act according to Itsuki's strategy in Union politics. In the autumn, Sirius and Itsuki are among the parents who have already advanced Ikki and Stella's wedding arrangements; Sirius still complains as a doting father but has accepted the marriage.

key_events.summary: Reacts furiously to Stella's kidnapping, then agrees to cooperate with Itsuki's rescue diplomacy.
Has already consented to and helped arrange Ikki and Stella's wedding.
